correctness.rationale: The classical linearization produces exact 2x2 pulse transfers. The bilinear numerator changes by zero under a two-pulse swap because the commutator is diagonal and annihilated by (1,1). Positivity of the second coordinate on every finite-through-forcing solution makes this algebra equivalent to basin membership. The three-pulse commutator identity and exact rational witness are independently reproduced by the packaged checker; bounded duration and sign conditions rule out in-pulse poles. Future q=1 behavior follows exactly from x' = 1-x².

value.rationale: A natural temporal-order threshold problem for temporary environmental stress has a universal two-pulse impossibility and a robust, exact three-pulse attainment. This is a sharp minimal-phase structure for basin outcome, not a merely numerical selected example. It clarifies how chronology affects finite stress recovery even when all constituent episodes are individually safe.
